A '''female Nautolan''' was a member of the [[Star Cabal]] during [[3640 BBY]] and was present aboard the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] in the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] when it was attacked by [[Cipher Nine]] and the remnants of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
